claims.statement: Open SWE's LangGraph manifest serves six graphs (agent, reviewer, analyzer, review-scout, chat, and scheduler) with the FastAPI app openswe.webapp:app, loads .env, and configures deleting checkpoints with a 60-minute sweep and 43,200-minute default TTL.

make dev checks that port 2024 is free and runs `uv run langgraph dev --no-browser --port 2024 --n-jobs-per-worker 10`; the full runtime serves LangGraph graphs and the FastAPI app together on localhost:2024.
make run executes `uv run uvicorn openswe.webapp:app --reload --port 8000` without the LangGraph runtime, so endpoints or dashboard actions that create runs require make dev instead.
make install runs `uv sync --extra dev`; Makefile targets run pytest through uv, Ruff for linting/formatting, and `ty check openswe tests` for type checking.

The local manifest uses a pre-release 0.15 LangGraph API range, while pyproject constrains `langgraph-api` to `>=0.15.0rc1,<0.16` and the standalone image uses the 0.15.1 Python 3.14 LangGraph API base.

langgraph.desktop.json is a separate desktop manifest that exposes only the agent graph, disables the built-in UI, configures `openswe.local_auth:auth` with Studio auth disabled, and uses a local checkpointer factory.
The pnpm workspace includes bridge-client, ui, desktop, cli, and tests/e2e, while Turborepo defines workspace dev, build, typecheck, test, and check tasks.
make web runs the root dashboard dev task, which filters Turborepo to open-swe-dashboard; Vite proxies backend prefixes to DASHBOARD_API_URL and defaults that target to http://localhost:2024.
Root JavaScript build, check, test, and typecheck scripts fan out through Turborepo, whereas lint uses oxlint and format/format:check use oxfmt directly at the repository root.
Turborepo caches .output/**, .vercel/output/**, and build/** for builds and treats DASHBOARD_API_URL, SOURCE_COMMIT, VERCEL, E2E_HARNESS, and VITE_* as cache-affecting build inputs.

The experimental Electron client bundles the dashboard, asks packaged users for a compatible backend rather than choosing a hosted default, and runs new This Mac work through a local sandbox bridge connected to that backend; legacy local threads remain on a bundled loopback server.

make install-desktop refuses a dirty checkout, switches and fast-forwards main before calling scripts/install_desktop.sh, whereas make install-checkout calls the installer for the current checkout without changing Git state.
scripts/install_desktop.sh is macOS-only; it requires Node, ditto, uv, Bun, and pnpm or Corepack, packages the desktop app, and stages then swaps it into /Applications or ~/Applications.
scripts/create_sandbox_snapshot.py uses SandboxClient to create a LangSmith sandbox snapshot from a Docker image, requires LANGSMITH_API_KEY or --api-key, and prints the resulting snapshot ID.

scripts/purge_wakeup_crons.py is a one-time cleanup for expired one-shot thread_wakeup crons; it supports --dry-run, resolves the target from --url or LANGGRAPH_URL, and resolves credentials from LANGGRAPH_API_KEY or LANGSMITH_API_KEY.

The root Dockerfile builds the standalone production LangGraph API server image, not a sandbox image, from langchain/langgraph-api:0.15.1-py3.14; it installs the repository, defines the FastAPI app, six graph registrations and checkpointer policy through environment variables, and exposes port 8000.

A standalone backend needs Agent Server DATABASE_URI and REDIS_URI plus LANGSMITH_API_KEY, LANGGRAPH_CLOUD_LICENSE_KEY, and public LANGGRAPH_URL; application analytics/storage also needs POSTGRES_URI, and scale-to-zero hosting is unsuitable because background workers depend on Redis and Postgres remaining available.

ui/Dockerfile is a multi-stage Node 24 Alpine build intended to run from the repository root; it installs the filtered workspace with a frozen lockfile, builds the dashboard Nitro output, and serves it as user node on port 8080, with DASHBOARD_API_URL read at runtime by the proxy.

The production Nitro proxy requires DASHBOARD_API_URL at request time rather than selecting a fallback, proxies the incoming path, query, headers and streamed non-GET body, preserves distinct Set-Cookie headers, and leaves redirects manual for OAuth.

The FastAPI app rejects wildcard DASHBOARD_ALLOWED_ORIGINS because credentials are enabled, allows configured origins plus open-swe://app for credentialed CORS, installs dashboard, plan, workflow, webhook, health and sandbox routers, and mounts the dashboard UI last.

The backend serves a dashboard from DASHBOARD_STATIC_DIR or the in-repository ui/.output/public build, or proxies a configured Vite dev server; its catch-all explicitly declines API, webhook, health, documentation, asset, and LangGraph runtime prefixes so it cannot shadow them.

Dashboard builds must use DASHBOARD_BASE_PATH equal to the backend LangGraph http.mount_prefix so their asset and client-router URLs remain under the mounted application; make build-dashboard accepts this variable and the platform manifest derives it from the mount prefix.

make tunnel requires NGROK_DOMAIN and tunnels local port 2024 through the webhooks-only ngrok policy, which returns 404 for all non-/webhooks/* paths to avoid publicly exposing unauthenticated local LangGraph routes.

The root Docker image does not build the dashboard, so standalone serving needs a prebuilt dashboard or DASHBOARD_STATIC_DIR; in contrast, the LangGraph Platform manifest attempts a mount-prefix-aware dashboard build and continues backend deployment if it fails.

A standalone deployment using LANGGRAPH_AUTH_TYPE=noop leaves raw LangGraph routes such as /threads, /runs, /assistants, and /store open to reachable network clients; operators should use LangSmith authentication or an authenticated/private network boundary because dashboard sessions and webhook signatures protect only custom routes.

When POSTGRES_URI is absent, make dev depends on a Compose postgres:16 service bound only to 127.0.0.1:5433 with a named open-swe-postgres volume and health check; an explicit POSTGRES_URI skips that local container.

make dev-ui runs Vite and the full backend together with DASHBOARD_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3000, allowing the browser to remain on port 2024 while non-reserved UI requests are proxied to Vite and HMR connects directly to Vite's port.

make migration invokes scripts/new_migration.py, which requires a message, selects the next numeric migration filename prefix, generates a random Alembic revision ID, and chains the revision to every current head.
make swagger regenerates swagger.json by importing openswe.webapp:app and serializing its OpenAPI schema; this documents the custom FastAPI backend rather than LangGraph runtime endpoints.
make cli requires Bun and builds cli/dist/oswe through the open-swe-cli package; its compile script uses Bun's compile mode to emit a single executable.
